subject.title: feat(agents)!: remove the stored default agent — sole agent or explicit ownership

question: Should an upgrade-only migration owner become a supported public plugin SDK input, or should core retain that handoff behind an internal bundled-channel adapter?
rationale: Either choice defines the long-term contract for external channel plugins; the current branch makes that decision implicitly while the repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep the SDK contract unchanged
options.body: Pass the captured migration owner through an internal core adapter for bundled channel migrations and remove migrationAgentId from the public SDK type.

options.title: Approve a public migration API
options.body: Retain migrationAgentId only with explicit maintainer approval, external-plugin semantics, compatibility tests, and documentation of its upgrade-only lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Keep the SDK contract unchanged
recommendation.body: Pass the captured migration owner through an internal core adapter for bundled channel migrations and remove migrationAgentId from the public SDK type.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history supplied for the two merged groundwork PRs and this branch concentrates the ownership-transition design in this area.
